title: Nine Hours of Patience
subtitle: 照料与护理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 照料与护理（生活与学习·健康与照护）
meta: 主题语境：照料与护理（生活与学习·健康与照护）　|　核心词汇：care　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 care 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to give ① care she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② care, meaning the nursing and not the worry, was nine hours long and was given by whoever came last; care, she said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ care in that ward had the same routine, and the ④ care at the end, meaning the one the nurse gave and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever recorded properly. Care, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ care was the whole of the worry, meaning the burden it carried and not the nursing. The ⑥ care, meaning the worry and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody carries and nobody questions; care, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both nursing and a worry. She said the worry is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ care had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the routine. The ⑧ care of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine hours and eleven years of giving; care, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ care I remember is the one at the end, which was recorded in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ kind of care, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being given; every care, she said, is a worry that has agreed to look like nursing. She said the worry was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 照料；护理；关心
B. n. 照料（指那些护理本身，与忧虑相对）
C. 固定搭配：give care 提供照料／护理
D. n. 照料（指病房里每一项）
E. n. 照料（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 忧虑；牵挂（抽象：与护理相对）
G. n. 那份牵挂（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The care, meaning the nursing and not the worry
care was the whole of the worry
the care had become a number in a report
The care of the whole thing
A kind of care, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: give care 意为“提供照料／护理”，1952 年母亲被派去提供她说不出名字的照料。
care 意为“照料”，指那些护理本身而不是忧虑，长九小时，由最后走的人来做。
care 指病房里每一项护理，每一项都是同样的流程。
care 指末尾那一项（护士做的那一项），是唯一有人认真记录过的。
care 意为“忧虑、牵挂”，与护理相对，父亲说 care 就是那份牵挂的全部。
care 为抽象用法，指那份牵挂本身，是一家人人人都担着、却没人质疑的东西。
care 意为“照料、护理”，到 1968 年这项 care 成了报告里的一个数字。
care 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九小时和十一年的付出。
care 意为“照料”，我记得的是末尾那一项，1973 年记录，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
care 为抽象总称，祖母说照料是唯一会因为被真心付出而变好的东西。

answers: In 1952 my mother was sent to give care she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson.
The care, meaning the nursing and not the worry, was nine hours long and was given by whoever came last.
Every care in that ward had the same routine.
The care at the end, meaning the one the nurse gave and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever recorded properly.
My father said care was the whole of the worry, meaning the burden it carried and not the nursing.
A kind of care, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being given.
